paths_reviewed.review_notes: The original 284-line `.js` implementation is now a 12-line dynamic-import compatibility shim; the canonical ESM implementation moved to `.mjs`. Package `validate:openapi` points directly to the `.mjs` entrypoint. Root package has no `type` field, so the shim stays compatible with CommonJS loading.

Canonical standalone validator parses local YAML and TypeScript source, checks structural fields/tags/operationIds/local schema refs and bidirectional critical session/WebAuthn/OIDC operation presence. Its TS analysis is deliberately bounded: constant booleans/! / && / || and direct conjunction comparisons, plus one regex-recognized revoke matcher; it is not a full route/call-graph analyzer. The script reads local files only and has no target/network/database side effects.

Integration contract was redirected to `.mjs` and adds a no-module-warning invocation plus reachability fixtures. It also has an optional runtime HTTP test: when API_RUNTIME_URL is absent it returns normally (ordinary test pass, not an explicit skip); with the variable set it fetches `${API_RUNTIME_URL}/openapi.json` without timeout or destination allowlist. Current environment has the variable unset, and this integration suite was not rerun in this round. Its top comment references scripts/validate-openapi-runtime.js, which is absent.
